0022600226.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 3-3 on the road, 7-3 in their last ten, 2nd in the Northwest) visit the Portland Trail Blazers (7-3, 2-2 at home, 7-3 in their last ten, 3rd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back) after a loss on the Thunder's last outing and a win on Portland's. Out for Oklahoma City are Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Portland is without Chris Youngblood (foot bruise), Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle). The Thunder trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 123-103 loss in Portland on November 10, though they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
